page.overview:
Who is Phillipa Louvois?

Captain Phillipa Louvois was a female Human 24th century Starfleet officer. She served in the Judge Advocate General office.

In 2355, she was the prosecutor in the court martial of Captain Jean-Luc Picard. Picard had been charged in connection with the loss of the , which Louvois relentlessly prosecuted. Picard was later absolved of all charges, but his relationship with Louvois remained strained after the court martial.

Picard and Louvois apparently had some sort of relationship that was more than just friendship, with Louvois commenting a decade later that Picard was still "a damn sexy man."

Shortly after the Stargazer court martial, she resigned from Starfleet, but returned subsequently.
